say:1:1820716001:1.source_cn: 你学得很快，领悟力很强。

choice_prompt:2:1820716001.source_cn: 你学得很快，领悟力很强。

say:3:1820716003:1.text: Now I'll show you a few simple moves you can actually use in a fight.
say:3:1820716003:1.source_cn: 接下来是一些简单有效的实战技巧，适合你这样的初学者。
say:3:1820716003:1.male: Now I'll show you a few simple moves you can actually use in a fight.
say:3:1820716003:1.female: Now I'll show you a few simple moves you can actually use in a fight.

say:4:1820716004:1.text: First, blocking. Catch the blow near the guard, where the blade is strongest. You'll have better control, and the sword is less likely to break.
say:4:1820716004:1.source_cn: 首先是格挡：格挡时需要用强部——就是靠近护手的部分。这...
say:4:1820716004:1.male: First, blocking. Catch the blow near the guard, where the blade is strongest. You'll have better control, and the sword is less likely to break.
say:4:1820716004:1.female: First, blocking. Catch the blow near the guard, where the blade is strongest. You'll have better control, and the sword is less likely to break.

say:5:1820716005:1.text: The section toward the tip is the weaker part of the blade. Use it for thrusts and slashes.
say:5:1820716005:1.source_cn: 与强部相对，剑尖的部分是弱部，用于突刺和劈砍。
say:5:1820716005:1.male: The section toward the tip is the weaker part of the blade. Use it for thrusts and slashes.
say:5:1820716005:1.female: The section toward the tip is the weaker part of the blade. Use it for thrusts and slashes.

say:6:1820716006:1.text: The Graveborn of Bantus have stiff bodies, so your blade may get stuck. If that happens, drive a knee into them or kick them away before they can grab you.
say:6:1820716006:1.source_cn: 班题斯亡灵的身体十分僵硬，若掌握不好力道，剑容易卡住。...
say:6:1820716006:1.male: The Graveborn of Bantus have stiff bodies, so your blade may get stuck. If that happens, drive a knee into them or kick them away before they can grab you.
say:6:1820716006:1.female: The Graveborn of Bantus have stiff bodies, so your blade may get stuck. If that happens, drive a knee into them or kick them away before they can grab you.

say:7:1820716007:1.text: They feel no pain and know no fear. Don't expect the usual tricks to work on them.
say:7:1820716007:1.source_cn: 他们没有痛觉，也不会恐惧，常规的控制手段是无效的。
say:7:1820716007:1.male: They feel no pain and know no fear. Don't expect the usual tricks to work on them.
say:7:1820716007:1.female: They feel no pain and know no fear. Don't expect the usual tricks to work on them.

say:8:1820716008:1.text: Target their joints. Once their movement is limited, they become easier to handle.
say:8:1820716008:1.source_cn: 着重攻击关节部位，便可削弱他们的行动力。
say:8:1820716008:1.male: Target their joints. Once their movement is limited, they become easier to handle.
say:8:1820716008:1.female: Target their joints. Once their movement is limited, they become easier to handle.

say:11:1820716010:1.text: You'll learn more by doing than by listening.
say:11:1820716010:1.source_cn: 比起理论，实践更为重要。
say:11:1820716010:1.male: You'll learn more by doing than by listening.
say:11:1820716010:1.female: You'll learn more by doing than by listening.

say:12:1820716011:1.text: Keep practicing. If we have time later, I'll show you more.
say:12:1820716011:1.source_cn: 抓紧时间练习吧。如果时间来得及，我再教你其他技巧。
say:12:1820716011:1.male: Keep practicing. If we have time later, I'll show you more.
say:12:1820716011:1.female: Keep practicing. If we have time later, I'll show you more.

say:13:1820716012:1.text: I can't afford to fail again... Not against Bantus.
say:13:1820716012:1.source_cn: 面对班题斯……这次我绝不能再次失误。
say:13:1820716012:1.male: I can't afford to fail again... Not against Bantus.
say:13:1820716012:1.female: I can't afford to fail again... Not against Bantus.

choice:10:1:2.text: Come on, teach me a few more tricks!
choice:10:1:2.male: Come on, teach me a few more tricks!
choice:10:1:2.female: Come on, teach me a few more tricks!

choice:2:0:1.text: I... think that was a compliment?
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 那还真是谢谢你的夸奖？
choice:2:0:1.male: I... think that was a compliment?
choice:2:0:1.female: I... think that was a compliment?

say:15:1820716002:1.text: She would be even stricter. She'd rather push you hard during training than watch you get hurt in a real fight.
say:15:1820716002:1.source_cn: 她只会比我更严格，因为她不希望你受伤。
say:15:1820716002:1.male: She would be even stricter. She'd rather push you hard during training than watch you get hurt in a real fight.
say:15:1820716002:1.female: She would be even stricter. She'd rather push you hard during training than watch you get hurt in a real fight.

choice:2:1:2.text: This was a mistake! I should've asked Estrilda to teach me!
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 我后悔了！我该去找爱丝的！
choice:2:1:2.male: This was a mistake! I should've asked Estrilda to teach me!
choice:2:1:2.female: This was a mistake! I should've asked Estrilda to teach me!
